o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *yāša-, a derivation from Proto-Turkic *yāĺ. By surface analysis, yaş (“year, age”) + -a.
Borrowed from Persian بیطرف (bi-taraf). By surface analysis, bi- + tərəf.
Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish آبونه (abone), from French abonné.
